# Document which filters the bypass deliberately skips

849 initially returns true before notification targeting checks. In 857 it still precedes the newly added interacted-ID check. The newer accepted filter puts the direct interacted-ID guard first, then bypass; the comment explains repeat _tab actions. Bypass still skips later policy/targeting checks in this function. In this family, keep the exception order explicit and test a repeated ID under bypass; the inspected bypass test does not cover that combination.

Scope: Notification filtering bypass order.
